question: 'Golden Girl' is the autobiography of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**P.T. Usha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **P.T. Usha is a former Indian track and field athlete who represented India in international competitions for over two decades.**
 
• She is often called the** "Golden Girl" **of Indian athletics due to her numerous achievements in the sport.
 
• Usha won several medals in international events, including the **Asian Games** and the** Asian Championships.**
 
• **She also narrowly missed out on a bronze medal at the 1984 Olympics in Los Angeles.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Divya Dutta** is an **Indian film actress** who has appeared in several Bollywood and Punjabi movies.
 
• **Saina Nehwal** is an **Indian badminton player** who has won several international tournaments, including the** Olympics bronze medal in 2012.**
 
• **Neena Gupta **is an **Indian film and television actress** who has appeared in several Hindi and Bengali movies.
